programmes.funder: European Space Agency (ESA) with the national space agency or regional co-funder
programmes.amount_note: EUR 50,000 equity-free funding for product and IP development, plus up to two years of incubation with technical support from ESA experts, business coaching, legal and IPR advice and fundraising support. Some national BICs add local top-up funding.
programmes.deadline_note: This ESA BIC runs its own call cycle with published cut-off dates, typically two to four per year. Contact the local centre for the next deadline.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the local ESA BIC to discuss suitability
Submit application documents before the local deadline
Tender Opening Board review, then presentation to the Tender Evaluation Board
Register a company in Romania before signing the incubation contract

eligibility.other_note: Business must use space-based systems, apply space technology in a non-space domain, or develop products and services for the space sector. Company must be registered in Romania.

programmes.source_snippet: €50k equity free funding for product and IP development

programmes.amount_note: Accelerator and scale-up programmes for Romanian and CEE tech startups; provides mentoring, corporate access and investor introductions rather than a fixed grant.

programmes.name_local: Programul Creștere Inteligentă, Digitalizare și Instrumente Financiare (PoCIDIF)
programmes.name_en: Smart Growth, Digitisation and Financial Instruments Programme
programmes.amount_note: EU-funded programme with calls for R&D, technology transfer and digitalisation of SMEs; ceilings set per call.

programmes.name_local: Programe Regionale (POR/PR) – sprijin pentru IMM inovatoare
programmes.name_en: Regional Programmes – support for innovative SMEs
programmes.amount_note: Each of Romania's eight development regions runs its own Programul Regional 2021-2027 with grants for SME innovation, digitalisation and technology transfer; ceilings differ by region and call.

programmes.funder: Ministerul Economiei, Digitalizării, Antreprenoriatului și Turismului (MEDAT)
programmes.amount_note: Non-repayable grant commonly set at up to RON 250,000 per beneficiary; the exact ceiling, co-financing and eligible expenditure are fixed in each edition's procedure.
programmes.deadline_note: Run in editions; the 2026 procedure was reported as modified. Check granturi.imm.gov.ro for the open window.
programmes.reopen_note: Start-Up Nation has been re-run in successive editions since 2017 with changing ceilings and scoring; each edition is announced by ministerial order with a short application window.

eligibility.other_note: Typically requires creating and maintaining jobs for a defined monitoring period.

programmes.name_local: UEFISCDI – Transfer tehnologic și proiecte inovative
programmes.name_en: UEFISCDI technology transfer and innovation projects
programmes.funder: Unitatea Executivă pentru Finanțarea Învățământului Superior, a Cercetării, Dezvoltării și Inovării (UEFISCDI)
programmes.amount_note: Competitive R&D and technology-transfer grants under the national PNCDI plan; ceilings set per instrument.
